crossRefs.note: Yahweh will bring a nation against you from far, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language…
He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold…
but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses;” therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift;” therefore…
One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on…
Behold, he will come up as clouds, and his chariots will be as the whirlwind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe…
“Put the trumpet to your lips! Something like an eagle is over Yahweh’s house, because they have broken my covenant…
Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly…
For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.
Flight will perish from the swift; and the strong won’t strengthen his force; neither shall the mighty deliver himself;
I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and he said, “Strike the tops of the pillars, that the thresholds may shake…

translations.web: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky. They chased us on the mountains. They set an ambush for us in the wilderness.
translations.bsb: Those who chased us were swifter than the eagles in the sky; they pursued us over the mountains and ambushed us in the wilderness.
translations.kjv: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
translations.asv: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the heavens: They chased us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
